forbidden: choosing a fallback based on scientific performance
changing the primary SABLE-MO method or 05e decision
using TARGET outcomes or biological annotations to configure a comparator
modifying published comparator mathematics to make it run
replacing a failed comparator with a new method not named in 05cmp0 without a new prospective versioned amendment
general_rule: Comparator availability is determined by a predeclared smoke-test process on 05dev0 synthetic fixtures only. No real TARGET data, confirmatory comparator result, biology, or outcome may be used to choose a fallback.
implementation_freeze_stage: A later 05cmp1 stage must record exact package/repository version, environment, commit or release, input adapter, hyperparameter-selection rule, random seeds, supported metrics, and numerical implementation hash before the first scientific comparator run.

MOVE.if_fallback_unavailable: Report the external deep comparator as implementation-unavailable; do not search for a new favorable VAE after results.
MOVE.if_preferred_unavailable: Activate AUTOENCODIX varix only after MOVE is formally marked unavailable by the frozen smoke-test rule.
MOVE.preferred: official move-dl release, target 1.5.0 unless a later official release is frozen in 05cmp1 before scientific runs

iClusterBayes2.if_unavailable: Report iClusterBayes family as implementation-unavailable; do not substitute a different classical method post hoc.
iClusterBayes2.same_family_fallback: legacy iClusterBayes from the official iClusterPlus package only if iClusterBayes2 is unavailable under the predeclared smoke-test rule

required_smoke_test: create an isolated environment using the authors' official installation path
run an official tutorial or minimal author-provided example if available
run the Paper 5 05dev0 synthetic valid fixture through the input adapter
verify that latent output has one row per synthetic sample and finite values for supported cases
verify deterministic/provenance recording under the frozen comparator seed policy to be defined in 05cmp1
do not inspect real TARGET values during smoke testing
unavailable_definition: A comparator is implementation-unavailable if both (1) the official published/repository installation path and (2) one dependency-pinned compatibility environment fail to complete the reference/synthetic smoke test without altering the published mathematical objective, loss, likelihood, or latent model.
